notes.title: Update v1.05
notes.notes:
『Player Behavior Improvements』
 -The player character can now dash indefinitely instead of using his stamina to do so.
 -Improved visibility by reducing the camera effect when the player approaches a slender man.


Originally, v1.04 was supposed to be the final version.
We've received a lot of reviews and direct messages about players being confused when they run out of stamina.
We believe that this is a great improvement, especially for future players.

Thank you for your reviews and messages.

notes.title: v1.04 Update
notes.notes:
[b]"Player camera fix"[/b]
-Suppressed the camera effect when enemies are near and the enemy within a certain field of view is displayed on the camera.
-Adjusted pitch and volume when using night vision.

notes.title: v1.03 Update
notes.notes:
[b]"Player Update"[/b]
-Reduce the time from running out of stamina to running.

[b]"Enemy update / correction"[/b]
 Slender
-Reduced the maximum and minimum warp time. 
　 (Because there are obstacles to progress beyond expectations)
-Reduced the minimum distance between players after warping
-Fixed issue where warp would not warp

 Ghost
-Improved search and player tracking speed.
-Reduced additional tracking time after player tracking.  
   (Because tracking is hard to stop even if you lose the player)
-The position has changed at the time of appearance.

notes.title: v1.02 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Player updates and fixes.[/b]
　　　-Stamina recovery speed has been greatly improved.
　　　-Game over for shooting enemies with the camera and then shooting them again has been eased.
　　　-The distance to detect ghost enemie has been increased slightly.


[b]Enemy behavior has been updated and fixed.[/b]
　　slender
　　　-The speed of movement has been increased.
      -The maximum and minimum warp start times have been shortened.
　　　-Adjustment to increase the distance from the player when warping.
      -Fixed an issue that prevented it from warping properly.

　　ghost
　　　-Reduced the speed of player tracking slightly.
　　　-Reduced the tracking time after losing a player track.
　　　-The speed of movement when exploring enemies has been greatly improved.
　　　-Fixed an issue that prevented the program from working under certain conditions.


[b]"Field updates and fixes.[/b]
　　　-moved the player's starting battery to a nearby chair.
　　　-Removed some objects that prevented the progress of the "office area".
　　　-Removed some objects that prevented progress in the library area.
　　　-Removed some obstacles in the corridor near the flashlight.
　　　-Fixed an issue where bookshelves in the library area could be accessed by squatting or moving.
　　　-Fixed an issue that caused some items in the library area to float in the air.


[b]Other updates and fixes.[/b]
　　　-Fixed an issue where enemies that were supposed to disappear would not disappear when clearing the game without certain enemies.

notes.title: Bug Fix v1.01
notes.notes:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed[/b]
・Fixed a bug where the enemy would continue to detect the floor and crash when warping
・Fixed an issue where certain enemies could get stuck when trying to move to their destination


[b]Other changes[/b]
・The visibility of the target item has been improved.
